SSC CHSL Result 2025-26 Out @ssc.gov.in

The SSC CHSL Tier 2 result has been released for the 2025-26 recruitment cycle. The result is out in PDF format for candidates who appeared for Mains exam conducted on 10th April. The CHSL result PDF lists the roll numbers andnames of candidates who have successfully cleared the Tier 2 exam. There are separate result lists for LDC/JSA and DEO posts. Candidates who appeared in the exam can check their qualifying status online at ssc gov in.

  • The SSC has introduced a sliding mechanism to fill SSC CHSL vacancies that may arise from non-joining. All the provisionally selected candidates must select their venue, date and slot from 20th to 22th August 2026.
  • The physical SSC CHSL sliding process is scheduled from 1st September to 3rd September 2026; absence will mean the candidate is not considered for the final result.

SSC CHSL Final Result 2026 PDF Download Link

Candidates who appeared for the Tier 2 exam can download the SSC CHSL Result 2026 PDF from the link given below. The result or merit list is available in PDF format, so no login is required. After opening the merit list pdf of ssc chsl, candidates can search their roll number or name using the Ctrl + F shortcut. SSC CHSL Result 2025-26 @ssc.gov.in

The result was officially declared on 17th August 2026 and candidates who appeared in Tier 2 can now check their qualifying status online.

SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2025-26 Out: Click to Check

How to Download SSC CHSL Tier 2 Result 2026?

Candidates can check and download the SSC CHSL Tier 2 Result 2026 by following the steps given below. The process is fully online and does not require login details.

  1. Go to the SSC official website www.ssc.gov.in or click on the link given above.
  2. Click on the “Result” tab under Quick Links
  3. Select the CHSL section.
  4. Click on the “Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination, 2025 (Tier-II)” link
  5. Open and Download the Result PDF file
  6. Use Ctrl + F to find your roll number or name

SSC CHSL Tier 2 Final Cut Off 2025-26

For SSC CHSLE 2025, the Computer Knowledge Test (CKT) cut-off is 13.5 marks out of 45 for General candidates, 11.25 marks for OBC and EWS candidates, and 9 marks for SC, ST, ESM, OH, HH, VH, and PwD-Others candidates. Check the below table for CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off Marks 2025-26:

Category CKT cut-off marks (out of 45) Typing Test: maximum errors DEO Grade A Skill Test: maximum errors
SC 9 10% 7%
ST 9 10% 7%
OBC 11.25 10% 7%
EWS 11.25 10% 7%
ESM 9 10% 5%
OH 9 10% 7%
HH 9 10% 7%
VH 9 10% 7%
PwD-Others 9 10% 7%
UR 13.5 7% 7%

In the LDC/JSA/JPA typing test, UR candidates can make up to 7% errors, while all other listed categories can make up to 10% errors. For the DEO Grade A Skill Test, the permitted error limit is 7% for all categories except ESM candidates, who can make up to 5% errors.

The SSC CHSL Final Result PDF has important information about candidates who have passed in the Tier 2 exam. It is important to properly check all the details stated in the result to avoid any mistakes.   • Qualifying Status

SSC CHSL Tier 2 Tie-Breaking Rules 2026

In case of a tie in Tier-II scores, SSC resolves it first through marks in Section I of Tier-II, then through Tier-I marks, and finally through date of birth, with the older candidate placed higher. This official tie-resolution sequence is applied until the tie is resolved for the CHSLE 2025 selection process.

Candidates’ online post and department preferences were also considered. Therefore, a candidate’s allocation depends on both merit position and the submitted preference order.

Candidates recommended in the FRTA should review the SSC notice on the sliding mechanism and complete the venue and slot-selection process on time.

SSC CHSL Tier 2 Qualifying Marks 2026

The SSC CHSL qualifying marks are the minimum scores required by candidates to pass the Tier 2 exam. These cut off marks are set by SSC and are different for different categories. Candidates need to score equal to or more than the minimum marks to be considered qualified and move to the next stage of the selection process.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
General (UR) 30%
OBC/EWS 25%
SC/ST/PwD 20%

What Happens After SSC CHSL Tier 2 Result 2025-26 Result?

After the SSC CHSL Tier 2 Result 2026 is out, candidates selected through the First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA) must take part in the sliding process. Candidates need to choose their venue, date and slot online from 20th to 22nd August 2026 at the official website. The physical sliding process will be held from 1st to 3rd September 2026. Candidates have to attend it physically and in case they are absent then they will not be considered for the final result. The final allocation list for SSC CHSL will be uploaded based on the sliding process.
